grammar: n. 毕业；毕业典礼。常用 graduation ceremony；graduate from 表示“从……毕业”，graduate 是动词或“毕业生”。
collocations: graduation ceremony; after graduation; graduate from high school
commonMistake: graduation 是名词；表达“毕业后”用 after graduation，而“毕业于某校”用 graduate from，不能把 graduation 当作动词。

example.english: After graduation, Mei plans to study engineering at university.
example.chinese: 毕业后，梅计划在大学学习工程。

application.prompt: After finishing high school, Mei celebrated her ___. A. pronunciation B. graduation
application.solution: B。解析：完成高中学业并庆祝的是 graduation（毕业）；pronunciation 是发音。

grammar: v. 投票；n. 选票、投票。过去式和过去分词为 voted；vote for/against sb or sth 表示投票支持/反对。
collocations: vote for a class leader; vote against the plan; cast a vote
commonMistake: 说“为某人投票”用 vote for；vote 后接人或方案时不要漏掉 for。

example.english: Our class will vote for a student to lead the graduation project.
example.chinese: 我们班将投票选出一名学生来负责毕业项目。

application.prompt: The class chose Mia to represent them. They voted ___ her. A. at B. for
application.solution: B。解析：投票支持某人用 vote for；句中 her 指被选出的代表。

grammar: n. 领导者；领袖。由动词 lead 加 -er 构成；lead 的过去式为 led，名词 leadership 表示领导力。
collocations: a team leader; a natural leader; show leadership
commonMistake: leader 指带领团队的人，lead 是“带领”这一动作；注意 lead 的过去式写作 led，不是 leaded。

example.english: A good leader listens to every member of the team.
example.chinese: 好的领导者会倾听团队每一位成员的意见。

application.prompt: She organizes the group and helps everyone work together, so she is a ___. A. listener B. leader
application.solution: B。解析：组织团队并带领大家合作的人是 leader（领导者）。

grammar: n. 介绍；展示；演讲。可数；常用 give/make a presentation；动词 present 表示介绍或展示。
collocations: give a presentation; a short presentation on science; presentation skills
commonMistake: presentation 是可数名词，表示一次展示时要用 a；常说 give a presentation，而不是 make a speech on every context。

example.english: Lily gave a presentation about her plan for the future.
example.chinese: 莉莉介绍了她的未来计划。

application.prompt: Each student will ___ a presentation about a career they like. A. make B. do
application.solution: A。解析：常用搭配是 make a presentation，意为作介绍或展示。

grammar: adj. 终身的；毕生的，通常放在名词前作定语。可构成 lifelong learning（终身学习）和 a lifelong friend（终生朋友）。
collocations: lifelong learning; a lifelong dream; a lifelong friend
commonMistake: lifelong 是形容词，表示持续一生；不要写成 life-long，也不要把它误当副词修饰动词。

example.english: Reading can be a lifelong source of joy.
example.chinese: 阅读可以成为一生的快乐源泉。

application.prompt: She has loved music since childhood and hopes to keep learning about it all her life. Music is her ___ interest. A. weekly B. lifelong
application.solution: B。解析：从童年持续一生的兴趣是 lifelong interest（终身的兴趣）。

grammar: n. 放映机；投影仪。可数名词，复数为 projectors；由 project（投射、展示）加 -or 构成。
collocations: a digital projector; use a projector; project an image onto a screen
commonMistake: projector 是设备，project 可作动词表示把图像投到屏幕上；不要将二者的词性混用。

example.english: We used a projector to show our photos on the classroom screen.
example.chinese: 我们用投影仪把照片放映在教室屏幕上。

application.prompt: The teacher connected the computer to a ___ to display the slides on the wall. A. printer B. projector
application.solution: B。解析：把幻灯片投到墙面上需要 projector（投影仪）。

grammar: adj. 职业的；职业技术的，常修饰 education、training 或 school。名词 vocation 指职业或使命感。
collocations: vocational education; vocational training; vocational school
commonMistake: vocational 是形容词，修饰教育或培训；表示“职业”这个名词时用 vocation，二者不能直接互换。

example.english: The school offers vocational training in cooking and car repair.
example.chinese: 这所学校提供烹饪和汽车维修方面的职业培训。

application.prompt: Students learn practical skills for a trade at a ___ school. A. vocal B. vocational
application.solution: B。解析：教授职业技能的学校是 vocational school（职业学校）；vocal 表示声音的。

grammar: pron. 无论什么；……的一切；det. 任何……。可引导名词性从句或让步状语从句，如 whatever you choose、whatever happens。
collocations: whatever happens; do whatever you can; whatever the reason
commonMistake: whatever 可表示“无论什么”，后面常接完整句子；它不等于 however（无论怎样），不要把两者混用。

example.english: Whatever job she chooses, she will keep learning new skills.
example.chinese: 无论她选择什么工作，她都会继续学习新技能。

application.prompt: ___ happens on the journey, stay with the group and follow the guide. A. Whatever B. However
application.solution: A。解析：从句缺少“发生的事情”作主语，用 whatever；however 表示“无论怎样”。

grammar: n. 小路；路线；道路。可数，复数为 paths；path to/towards sth 也可表示通往某目标的途径。
collocations: a narrow path; a path through the forest; the path to success
commonMistake: path 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the；表示“成功之路”常用 the path to success。

example.english: A clear study plan can put you on the path to success.
example.chinese: 明确的学习计划能让你走上成功之路。

application.prompt: The sign points to a narrow ___ through the forest. A. path B. cloud
application.solution: A。解析：穿过森林的小路是 path；句中 narrow 修饰可数名词。

grammar: adv. 主要地；大部分地。由形容词 main 加 -ly 构成；常放在实义动词前或 be 动词后。
collocations: mainly because; mainly based on; mainly used for
commonMistake: mainly 是副词，修饰动词、形容词或整句；main 是形容词，如 the main reason，不能在名词前误用 mainly。

example.english: The course is mainly for students who want to learn design.
example.chinese: 这门课程主要面向想学习设计的学生。

application.prompt: The club is ___ made up of students from Grade Nine. A. main B. mainly
application.solution: B。解析：空格处修饰 made up，需用副词 mainly（主要地）。

grammar: adj. 沉默的；无声的。可作表语或定语；silence 是名词，silently 是副词。
collocations: keep/remain silent; a silent room; silent about the problem
commonMistake: keep silent 表示保持沉默；silence 是名词，不能说 keep silence 来表达常见的“保持安静”。

example.english: The room became silent as the principal began to speak.
example.chinese: 校长开始讲话时，房间里安静了下来。

application.prompt: When the announcement began, everyone stopped talking and stayed ___. A. silent B. silence
application.solution: A。解析：stay 是系动词，后接形容词 silent（沉默的、安静的）。

grammar: v. 发音；读（音）。pronunciation 是名词；pronounce a word correctly 表示把一个词读正确。
collocations: pronounce a name; pronounce the word correctly; difficult to pronounce
commonMistake: 动词是 pronounce，名词是 pronunciation；名词中多出一个 i，并且重音位置也不同。

example.english: Could you pronounce this new word slowly for me?
example.chinese: 你能为我慢慢读一下这个新单词吗？

application.prompt: I know the meaning of her surname, but I don't know how to ___ it. A. pronunciation B. pronounce
application.solution: B。解析：how to 后接动词原形，句意是“不知道怎么读这个姓氏”，用 pronounce。

grammar: adv. 在国外；到国外。常用 go/study/live abroad；abroad 前通常不加 to 或 in。
collocations: study abroad; travel abroad; from abroad
commonMistake: abroad 是地点副词，说“去国外”用 go abroad，不说 go to abroad；“在国外”也通常不说 in abroad。

example.english: My cousin hopes to study abroad after she graduates.
example.chinese: 我表姐希望毕业后出国留学。

application.prompt: Tom received a scholarship and plans to study ___ next year. A. abroad B. foreign
application.solution: A。解析：study 后用地点副词 abroad（在国外）；foreign 是形容词，需修饰名词。

grammar: v. 毕业；n. 毕业生。作动词时常用 graduate from a school/university；第三人称单数 graduates，过去式 graduated。
collocations: graduate from university; a recent graduate; graduate with a degree
commonMistake: graduate from 表示“从某校毕业”；不要用 graduate a school 表示毕业于某校。

example.english: He graduated from university last year and found a job in a hospital.
example.chinese: 他去年大学毕业，并在一家医院找到工作。

application.prompt: After four years of study, Nina will ___ from university in June. A. graduation B. graduate
application.solution: B。解析：will 后接动词原形；graduate from 表示“从大学毕业”。

grammar: adj. 连续的；持续不断的，强调中间没有间断。副词为 continuously；名词 continuity 表示连续性。
collocations: continuous rain; continuous improvement; continuous process
commonMistake: continuous 强调没有中断；副词要写 continuously。不要把形容词 continuous 直接放在动词后作方式状语。

example.english: The machine needs a continuous supply of clean water.
example.chinese: 这台机器需要持续不断的清洁供水。

application.prompt: The river provides a ___ flow of water throughout the year. A. continuous B. occasional
application.solution: A。解析：全年不断的水流是 continuous flow；occasional 表示偶尔发生的。

grammar: n. 女士；夫人。Madam 可用于正式称呼不知姓名的女性，信件开头常见 Dear Madam；普通对话中多用 Ms 加姓氏。
collocations: Dear Madam; excuse me, madam; ladies and gentlemen
commonMistake: Madam 用作正式称呼时常单独使用或放在信件称呼中；已知对方姓名时通常用 Ms + 姓氏。

example.english: Dear Madam, I am writing to ask about the evening course.
example.chinese: 尊敬的女士：我写信想咨询晚间课程的情况。

application.prompt: You are writing a formal letter to a woman whose name you do not know. Begin with “Dear ___”. A. Madam B. Misses
application.solution: A。解析：正式信件中不知女性姓名时可用 Dear Madam；Misses 不是这样的称呼。

grammar: v. 翻译；把……译成……。常用 translate sth from A into B；名词 translation，译者为 translator。
collocations: translate a poem; translate from Chinese into English; machine translation
commonMistake: 表达“把A译成B”用 translate A into B；into 后接译成的目标语言，不要与 from 的来源语言颠倒。

example.english: The students translated the story from English into Chinese.
example.chinese: 学生们把这个故事从英语翻译成了中文。

application.prompt: We need to translate this notice ___ English into French. A. into B. from
application.solution: B。解析：表示来源语言用 from，目标语言前用 into；句意为“从英语译成法语”。

grammar: adj. 兼职的；部分时间的，常作定语修饰 job、work 或 student。作副词短语时也常写 work part time。
collocations: a part-time job; part-time work; work part time
commonMistake: 名词前作定语时常写带连字符的 part-time job；用作副词时可写 work part time，注意词性和位置。

example.english: She has a part-time job at a bookshop on weekends.
example.chinese: 她周末在一家书店做兼职。

application.prompt: Because he is still at school, he works only a few hours a day in a ___. A. part-time job B. full-time job
application.solution: A。解析：每天只工作几个小时的工作是 part-time job（兼职工作）。

grammar: adj. 全职的；全日制的，常修饰 job、work 或 student。作副词短语时常写 work full time。
collocations: a full-time job; a full-time student; work full time
commonMistake: full-time 作前置定语时通常加连字符；work full time 中 full time 作副词短语，不要把它写作 full-timely。

example.english: After graduation, he hopes to find full-time work as a designer.
example.chinese: 毕业后，他希望找到一份设计师全职工作。

application.prompt: She works from morning to evening five days a week, so she has a ___ position. A. part-time B. full-time
application.solution: B。解析：一周工作五天且从早到晚的岗位是 full-time（全职的）。

grammar: adj. 年长的；级别较高的；高年级的。常用 senior student、senior manager；比较关系可说 senior to sb。
collocations: a senior student; senior citizens; be senior to someone
commonMistake: senior 表示“比某人年长/级别高”时用 senior to，不用 senior than；senior 本身不加 -er。

example.english: As a senior student, Kai helps younger students prepare for exams.
example.chinese: 作为一名高年级学生，凯帮助低年级学生备考。

application.prompt: Mr Green has worked here longer and holds a higher position. He is ___ to Mr Lee. A. senior B. more senior than
application.solution: A。解析：senior 表示级别更高时搭配 to，故用 senior to Mr Lee。

grammar: adj. 技术的；技能的。常修饰 problem、skill、support；名词 technique 指技巧，technician 指技术人员。
collocations: technical skills; technical support; a technical problem
commonMistake: technical 是形容词，修饰名词；technically 是副词，表示“从技术角度看”，不能用 technically skills。

example.english: The course teaches students the technical skills needed to repair computers.
example.chinese: 这门课程教学生维修电脑所需的技术技能。

application.prompt: The machine stopped working, so we called the company for ___ support. A. technician B. technical
application.solution: B。解析：support 前需要形容词 technical（技术支持）；technician 是技术人员。

grammar: adj. 感激的。常用 be grateful to sb for sth；也可接 to do 或 that 从句。名词为 gratitude。
collocations: be grateful to someone; grateful for your help; deeply grateful
commonMistake: 感谢某人做了某事用 grateful to sb for sth；to 后接人，for 后接感谢的原因或帮助。

example.english: I am grateful to my teacher for encouraging me to try again.
example.chinese: 我很感激老师鼓励我再试一次。

application.prompt: We are grateful ___ our coach for staying late to help us. A. to B. for
application.solution: A。解析：感谢某人用 grateful to our coach；for 后面才接感谢的事情。

grammar: n. 鼓励；鼓舞。多作不可数名词；动词 encourage 常用 encourage sb to do sth，形容词为 encouraging。
collocations: words of encouragement; give someone encouragement; encouragement to keep trying
commonMistake: encouragement 通常不可数，不说 an encouragement 表示一次鼓励；“鼓励某人做某事”用 encourage sb to do。

example.english: Her friends' encouragement helped her finish the difficult project.
example.chinese: 朋友们的鼓励帮助她完成了这个困难的项目。

application.prompt: The teacher encouraged Ben ___ his idea at the meeting. A. sharing B. to share
application.solution: B。解析：固定结构是 encourage sb to do sth，句中 Ben 后接 to share。

grammar: phr. 行业；职业领域。常用于 What line of work are you in?（你从事哪一行？）；line 在此表示领域或类型。
collocations: in the same line of work; a different line of work; what line of work
commonMistake: line of work 指职业领域，询问职业常说 What line of work are you in?；不要按字面理解为“工作中的一条线”。

example.english: My aunt is in the same line of work as my mother; they are both nurses.
example.chinese: 我姑姑和我妈妈从事同一行业；她们都是护士。

application.prompt: “What ___ are you in?” “I work in education.” A. line of work B. line of traffic
application.solution: A。解析：询问某人从事的行业用 What line of work are you in?，回答是教育行业。

grammar: phr. 记住；把……记在心中。可说 bear in mind that... 或 bear sth in mind；bear 的过去式为 bore，过去分词为 borne。
collocations: bear in mind that; bear this advice in mind; keep in mind
commonMistake: bear ... in mind 中间可放 this、the rule 等宾语；接完整句子时用 bear in mind that...，不要漏掉 that。

example.english: Bear in mind that the library closes at six on Fridays.
example.chinese: 记住，图书馆周五六点关门。

application.prompt: Please ___ in mind that the final page must include your name. A. bear B. carry
application.solution: A。解析：固定表达是 bear in mind that...，意为“记住……”。

grammar: n. 勤勉；勤奋。通常不可数；形容词 diligent，副词 diligently。
collocations: with diligence; diligence and patience; show diligence
commonMistake: diligence 是名词，描述人的品质时可用 her diligence；形容词要用 diligent，如 a diligent student。

example.english: With patience and diligence, he improved his English step by step.
example.chinese: 凭着耐心和勤奋，他一步步提高了英语水平。

application.prompt: She checks every detail carefully and works hard each day. Her ___ impressed the teacher. A. diligent B. diligence
application.solution: B。解析：形容词性物主代词 her 后接名词 diligence（勤奋）。

grammar: adv. 同样地；平等地。由 equal 加 -ly 构成；divide/share sth equally 表示平均分配。
collocations: equally important; share equally; divide the work equally
commonMistake: equally 是副词，修饰形容词或动作；名词前作定语时用 equal，如 equal chances，不用 equally chances。

example.english: The students shared the work equally and finished before lunch.
example.chinese: 学生们平均分担了工作，并在午饭前完成了。

application.prompt: The four teammates divided the tasks ___ so that no one had more work. A. equally B. equal
application.solution: A。解析：修饰动词 divided 用副词 equally，表示平均地分配。

grammar: v. 珍视；珍爱；怀有（希望、回忆等）。第三人称单数 cherishes，过去式 cherished。
collocations: cherish a memory; cherish the opportunity; cherish the hope
commonMistake: cherish 后直接接珍视的人或事物，不用 cherish for；第三人称单数按以 sh 结尾的规则加 -es。

example.english: I will always cherish the memories of our final year at school.
example.chinese: 我会永远珍藏我们在校最后一年的回忆。

application.prompt: Although the trip ended years ago, we still ___ the happy memories. A. cherish B. refuse
application.solution: A。解析：仍然珍视快乐回忆用 cherish the memories。

grammar: n. 柠檬。可数，复数为 lemons；表示柠檬汁常说 lemon juice，表示一片柠檬用 a slice of lemon。
collocations: a slice of lemon; lemon juice; a sour lemon
commonMistake: lemon 是可数名词，单数前要有冠词或限定词；lemon juice 中 lemon 作名词定语，juice 通常不可数。

example.english: Add a slice of lemon to the tea to give it a fresh taste.
example.chinese: 在茶里加一片柠檬，让味道更清新。

application.prompt: The tea tastes too sweet, so Dad adds a slice of ___. A. lemonade B. lemon
application.solution: B。解析：一片可切开的水果是 lemon（柠檬）；lemonade 指柠檬饮料。

grammar: n. 柠檬水；柠檬汽水。通常作不可数名词；表示一杯时可说 a glass of lemonade。
collocations: a glass of lemonade; fresh lemonade; make lemonade
commonMistake: lemonade 通常不可数，表示一杯要说 a glass of lemonade，不说 a lemonade water。

example.english: We made fresh lemonade with lemons from the garden.
example.chinese: 我们用园子里的柠檬做了新鲜柠檬水。

application.prompt: It is hot outside. Would you like a glass of ___? A. lemonade B. lemon
application.solution: A。解析：盛在杯中饮用的是 lemonade（柠檬水）；lemon 是柠檬这种水果。

grammar: v. 欺骗；作弊；n. 骗子或作弊行为。常说 cheat in an exam/on a test；cheat sb 表示欺骗某人。
collocations: cheat in an exam; cheat on a test; cheat someone out of money
commonMistake: 表示考试作弊可用 cheat in an exam 或 cheat on a test；cheat sb out of sth 表示骗走某人的东西。

example.english: The student admitted that he had cheated on the test.
example.chinese: 这名学生承认自己在考试中作弊了。

application.prompt: The teacher saw him looking at another student's paper during the exam. He was trying to ___. A. cheat B. graduate
application.solution: A。解析：考试时偷看他人答卷属于 cheat（作弊）。

grammar: prep. & conj. 直到……为止；在……以前。与 until 意思相同；作连词时后接完整从句。
collocations: till tomorrow; wait till the bus arrives; from morning till night
commonMistake: till 可作介词接时间点，也可作连词接完整句子；表示将来时的时间从句时通常用一般现在时。

example.english: We waited till the rain stopped before walking home.
example.chinese: 我们一直等到雨停才步行回家。

application.prompt: Stay here till your mother ___ to pick you up. A. will come B. comes
application.solution: B。解析：till 引导时间状语从句，指将来时从句用一般现在时 comes。

grammar: v. 通知；告知。常用 inform sb of/about sth 或 inform sb that...；名词 information 通常不可数。
collocations: inform someone of a change; inform the class that; keep someone informed
commonMistake: inform sb of/about sth 表示把某事告知某人；information 不可数，不能说 an information。

example.english: Please inform the office if your contact details change.
example.chinese: 如果你的联系方式有变，请通知办公室。

application.prompt: The school will ___ parents of the new graduation date by email. A. inform B. information
application.solution: A。解析：will 后接动词原形；inform sb of sth 表示通知某人某事。

grammar: n. 职业；（尤指适合个人的）工作或使命。形容词 vocational 表示职业的；常与 career、calling 区分语境。
collocations: choose a vocation; a vocation in teaching; vocational training
commonMistake: vocation 指职业或使命感，vocational 是形容词；不要把 vocation 与 vacation（假期）混淆。

example.english: Teaching became her vocation because she loved helping young people learn.
example.chinese: 因为喜欢帮助年轻人学习，教书成了她的职业使命。

application.prompt: He wants a career helping sick people, so nursing may be the right ___. A. vacation B. vocation
application.solution: B。解析：适合个人的职业方向是 vocation；vacation 是假期。

grammar: n. 耐心；忍耐力。通常不可数；形容词 patient 常用于 be patient with sb，或 have the patience to do sth。
collocations: have patience; be patient with children; the patience to listen
commonMistake: patience 是名词，patient 是形容词或病人；说“对某人有耐心”用 be patient with sb。

example.english: Learning to play the piano takes time and patience.
example.chinese: 学习弹钢琴需要时间和耐心。

application.prompt: The teacher explained the rule again and again without getting angry. She was very ___ with us. A. patience B. patient
application.solution: B。解析：be 动词后作表语用形容词 patient；patience 是名词。

grammar: adv. 诚实地；说真的。由 honest 加 -ly 构成；名词为 honesty。可修饰动词，也可用于句首表达坦率看法。
collocations: answer honestly; speak honestly; honestly speaking
commonMistake: honestly 是副词，修饰 answer、speak 等动词；描述人的品质要用 honest，如 an honest answer。

example.english: Please answer honestly, even if you made a mistake.
example.chinese: 即使你犯了错，也请如实回答。

application.prompt: The form asks you to describe your experience truthfully. Please answer ___. A. honestly B. honest
application.solution: A。解析：修饰动词 answer 要用副词 honestly，表示诚实地回答。

grammar: phr. 落后；跟不上。过去式为 fell behind；常说 fall behind in a subject 或 fall behind schedule。
collocations: fall behind in class; fall behind schedule; help someone catch up
commonMistake: fall behind 的过去式为 fell behind；表达落后于进度可说 fall behind schedule 或 fall behind in class，不要误写 falled behind。

example.english: If you miss too many lessons, you may fall behind in maths.
example.chinese: 如果你缺课太多，数学可能会落下。

application.prompt: After missing two weeks of school, Leo had to work hard to ___ in science. A. fall behind B. catch up
application.solution: B。解析：努力追上进度用 catch up；fall behind 表示落后，语意相反。

grammar: adj. 可达到的；可实现的。由 achieve 加 -able 构成；名词 achievement，表示成就。
collocations: an achievable goal; realistic and achievable; achievable target
commonMistake: achievable 描述目标“能够实现”；achieved 是 achieve 的过去式或过去分词，表示“已经实现”，不要混用。

example.english: Breaking a large task into small steps makes it more achievable.
example.chinese: 把大任务分成小步骤会让它更容易完成。

application.prompt: A goal that you can reach with steady effort is ___. A. achievable B. impossible
application.solution: A。解析：通过持续努力能够达到的目标是 achievable（可实现的）。

grammar: adj. 同伴的；同类的，常放在名词前，如 fellow student、fellow worker；也可作名词表示伙伴或同伴。
collocations: a fellow student; fellow citizens; a fellow of the college
commonMistake: 作“同伴的”时 fellow 通常放在名词前，如 a fellow student；不要在 fellow 和该名词之间插入副词。

example.english: A fellow student showed me where to find the science lab.
example.chinese: 一位同学告诉我科学实验室在哪里。

application.prompt: Someone in the same class as you can be called a ___. A. fellow student B. foreign student
application.solution: A。解析：fellow student 指同伴或同班同学；foreign student 指外国学生。

examTags: 词汇·否定前缀与形容词
grammar: adj. 难以忘怀的；令人难忘的。由 un- + forget + -able 构成；forgettable 表示容易被忘记的。
collocations: an unforgettable experience; an unforgettable day; make a trip unforgettable
commonMistake: unforgettable 表示“不会忘记的、令人难忘的”；forget 是动词，forgettable/unforgettable 是形容词。

example.english: The school concert was an unforgettable experience for everyone.
example.chinese: 这场校园音乐会是每个人都难以忘怀的一次经历。

application.prompt: We still talk about the trip years later because it was ___. A. forgetful B. unforgettable
application.solution: B。解析：多年后仍会谈起，说明这次旅行令人难忘，用 unforgettable。

grammar: phr. 由衷地；发自内心地。常用 from the bottom of one's heart；one's 按主语替换为 my、your、her 等所有格。
collocations: thank someone from the bottom of my heart; speak from the heart; a heartfelt thank-you
commonMistake: 短语中 bottom 前要有 the，heart 前要用所有格，如 from the bottom of my heart；不能漏掉 of。

example.english: I thank my parents from the bottom of my heart for their support.
example.chinese: 我由衷感谢父母一直以来的支持。

application.prompt: “Thank you ___ for helping me through a difficult year,” she said. A. from the bottom of my heart B. by the end of my heart
application.solution: A。解析：from the bottom of my heart 表示“由衷地、发自内心地”；句中表达真诚感谢。

grammar: phr. 值得做某事。常用 be worth doing；worth 后接名词或动名词，不定式通常不直接跟在 worth 后。
collocations: be worth doing; be worth a visit; well worth the effort
commonMistake: be worth 后接动名词形式表达“值得做”，如 worth reading；动名词主动形式常有被动含义，不说 be worth to read。

example.english: This book is worth reading because it explains the topic clearly.
example.chinese: 这本书值得一读，因为它把这个主题解释得很清楚。

application.prompt: The museum has a rare collection, so it is worth ___ this weekend. A. to visit B. visiting
application.solution: B。解析：固定句型 be worth doing，故用 visiting，表示博物馆值得参观。
